title.narrative: DCM BBVA Colombia Biodiversity Subordinated Debt B3T2

description.narrative: The proposed project consists of a consists of an up to US$45 million 10-year non-call 5 (10NC5) Basel 3 Tier II (B3T2) compliant subordinated bond to be issued by Banco Bilbao Vizcaya Argentaria Colombia S.A. (BBVA Colombia or the Bank) and subscribed by IFC. The proceeds of the bond will be used to finance businesses and projects that prevent losses in biodiversity and/or protect nature comprising activities related to productive land uses for climate-smart agriculture, sustainable freshwater/marine production, waste and plastic management, eco-tourism, forestry and plantations, land use conservation and marine habitat conservation.

Together with the prior biodiversity bond issued by the Bank, IFC anticipates that the project will increase access to finance available for climate-related projects in Colombia, through the funding of businesses and projects that conserve biodiversity and provide nature-based solutions. Additionally, the project, as part of a series of climate-finance related investments by IFC in Colombia, will support greater sustainability by promoting and reinforcing international best practices in climate finance, including those on the financing of biodiversity projects. IFCs investments is expected to provide diversification and support market creation through the demonstration and replication channel.
